items.w: רננו צדיקים ביהוה לישרים נאוה תהלה
items.title: JOYFUL SONG
items.quote: You tzaddikim, cry out joyously to Hashem. Praise is fitting for the upright.
items.text: If you have done teshuvah, you are surely forgiven for your sins and so you may join the righteous people of the world in joyfully praising our Creator.

items.w: הודו ליהוה בכנור בנבל עשור זמרו לו
items.title: MUSIC
items.quote: Gratefully praise Hashem with the harp; sing to Him with the ten-tone bagpipe.
items.text: Add variety in your music of praise to reflect the many facets of Creation.

items.w: שירו לו שיר חדש היטיבו נגן בתרועה
items.quote: Sing to Him a new song; skillfully perform music with the sound of the trumpet.

items.w: כי ישר דבר יהוה וכל מעשהו באמונה
items.title: MIDDOS
items.quote: For the word of Hashem is upright. All His deeds are with fairness.
items.text: The laws of nature are not chaotic, but are consistent and dependable. Hashem administers them with fairness and kindness.

items.w: אהב צדקה ומשפט חסד יהוה מלאה הארץ
items.quote: He loves righteous justice and [the discipline of] judgement. The earth is filled with the kindness of Hashem.

items.w: בדבר יהוה שמים נעשו וברוח פיו כל צבאם
items.title: CREATION
items.quote: The heavens were made by the word of Hashem and all their multitudes by the breath of His mouth.
items.text: Living beings were fashioned in astoundingly complex detail and are supported by the elaborate infrastructure of the physical world.

items.w: כנס כנד מי הים נתן באצרות תהומות
items.quote: He gathers in the waters of the sea like a high wall. He puts them into storehouses of deep waters.

items.w: ייראו מיהוה כל הארץ ממנו יגורו כל ישבי תבל
items.title: AWE
items.quote: Let the entire earth be in awe of Him. Let all inhabitants of the world fear Him.
items.text: Recognition and awareness of Hashem requires that you be in awe of Him.

items.w: יהוה הפיר עצת גוים הניא מחשבות עמים
items.title: HISTORY
items.quote: Hashem revokes the counsel of nations. He thwarts the thoughts of peoples.
items.text: Hashem controls the course of history throughout all generations.

items.w: עצת יהוה לעולם תעמד מחשבות לבו לדר ודר
items.title: ETERNITY
items.quote: The counsel of Hashem will endure forever. The thoughts of His heart [as expressed in His Torah] from generation to generation.
items.text: The Torah of Hashem is eternal, as are His principles of truth and goodness.

items.w: אשרי הגוי אשר יהוה אלהיו העם בחר לנחלה לו
items.title: RELATIONSHIP
items.quote: Fortunate is the nation whose G-d is Hashem, the people that He has chosen as His own inheritance.
items.text: We Jews rejoice together in our good fortune at having been granted a relationship with Hashem.

items.w: היצר יחד לבם המבין אל כל מעשיהם
items.title: OMNISCIENCE
items.quote: He Who fashions their heart as one, He discerns all their doings.
items.text: Hashem observes all our actions and knows our motivations.

items.w: הנה עין יהוה אל יראיו למיחלים לחסדו
items.title: JUSTICE
items.quote: Behold, the eye of Hashem is toward those who fear Him, to those who put their hope in His kindness.
items.text: Hashem rewards all who serve Him faithfully.

items.w: נפשנו חכתה ליהוה עזרנו ומגננו הוא
items.title: DEVOTION
items.quote: Our soul has waited for Hashem. He is our help and our shield.
items.text: Declare your bitachon and your devotion to Hashem.

items.w: כי בו ישמח לבנו כי בשם קדשו בטחנו
items.quote: [We wait] because with Him our hearts will be glad, that we trusted in His Holy Name.

items.w: יהי חסדך יהוה עלינו כאשר יחלנו לך
items.title: KINDNESS
items.quote: Hashem, may Your kindness be upon us, as we are hoping for You.
items.text: May Hashem in His eternal kindness grant us a yeshuah soon in our days.
